logline: A prequel to Yellowstone set in the 1920s Dutton ranch during Prohibition, the Great Depression, and the drought that turned the West to dust - anchored by the ineffable star power of Harrison Ford and Helen Mirren.

renewal.note: Two-season Yellowstone prequel concluded April 6, 2025. Creator Taylor Sheridan confirmed the story as complete.

bollymeter.basis: 88% RT anchored by Harrison Ford and Helen Mirren's combined weight; critics noted the unrelenting grimness of Sheridan's frontier tragedy but credited the casting as a sufficient reason to watch.

seasons.review_body: Season 1 premiered December 18, 2022 as Taylor Sheridan's second Yellowstone prequel, set in 1923 during Prohibition, the Great Depression, and a cattle industry under stress from federal oversight and ecological collapse. Harrison Ford and Helen Mirren play Jacob and Cara Dutton, the patriarch and matriarch holding the ranch together against multiple converging threats. Critics approved at 88 percent, with the consensus noting the series was 'distinguished by the ineffable star power of Harrison Ford and Helen Mirren' and that it represented 'another solid if unrelentingly grim addition' to the Yellowstone universe. The darkness of tone and the slow pace of the frontier-epic structure divided casual viewers from committed fans of the franchise.

bollymeter.basis: 100% RT in Season 2 as the show resolved its storylines with more emotional momentum than Season 1's grim setup promised; the finale was the most emotionally complete ending in the Yellowstone universe.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 premiered February 23, 2025 and concluded April 6, 2025 with a perfect Rotten Tomatoes score, representing a significant upgrade from the first season's critical standing. Critics credited the narrative payoff: storylines that Season 1 had established with deliberate slowness came to fruition with genuine emotional impact in the second run. Ford and Mirren's performances, which had already been praised, were credited with even greater authority as the material matched the depth the stars were bringing. The finale was widely reviewed as the most satisfying conclusion in the Yellowstone franchise - an ending that earned its grief.
seasons.season_over_season: Delivers the payoff Season 1's grim setup withheld. The finale lands with emotional proportion to the investment, a craft that shows up in its high RT score.
